name: Now Playing – Operational Dashboard
description: Station scrapes, Spotify API latency, chart ops, cache health

pages.name: Stations
pages.description: Live station scrape health and now-playing update counters

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(durationMs, 95) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SourceScrape' FACET sourceId TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 50
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE success = 0) AS 'Error %' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SourceScrape' FACET sourceId SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'StationTrackUpdated' FACET station TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 50
SELECT average(durationMs) AS 'avg', max(durationMs) AS 'max' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'StationCrawlCycle' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT sum(updatedCount) AS 'Updated', sum(errorCount) AS 'Errors' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'StationCrawlCycle' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(attempts) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SourceScrape' FACET sourceId TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 50
SELECT sum(newTrackCount) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'HistoryChartNewTracks' FACET station TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 50

pages.name: Spotify API
pages.description: Latency and error rates per Spotify API method + search cache

widgets.title: Spotify API Latency P95 per Method (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(durationMs, 95) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifyApiCall' FACET method TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Spotify API Error Rate per Method (%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE success = 0) AS 'Error %' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifyApiCall' FACET method SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Spotify API Call Volume per Method

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifyApiCall' FACET method TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 20
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE hit = 1) AS 'Cache Hit %' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifySearchCache' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifySearchCache' FACET cases(WHERE hit = 1 AS 'Hit', WHERE hit = 0 AS 'Miss') SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(durationMs) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifySearchCache' FACET cases(WHERE hit = 1 AS 'Hit', WHERE hit = 0 AS 'Miss') TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT histogram(durationMs, 50, 20) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'SpotifyApiCall' SINCE 1 hour ago

pages.name: Charts
pages.description: Weekly chart collection and Spotify playlist sync health

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartCollection' FACET chartKey TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 30
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE success = 1) AS 'Success %' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartCollection' FACET chartKey SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 30
SELECT sum(trackCount) AS 'Total Tracks', sum(spotifyResolvedCount) AS 'Spotify Resolved' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartCollection' FACET chartKey SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 30
SELECT sum(spotifyResolvedCount) / sum(trackCount) * 100 AS 'Resolution %' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartCollection' AND trackCount > 0 FACET chartKey SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 30
SELECT average(durationMs) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartSpotifySync' FACET chartKey TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Chart Sync – Tracks Pushed to Spotify

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(trackCount) AS 'Tracks Synced' FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartSpotifySync' AND success = 1 FACET chartKey SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Chart Collection Skipped (already exists for week)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartCollectionSkipped' FACET chartKey TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 30
SELECT count(*) FROM ServerMetric WHERE measurement = 'ChartSpotifySync' AND success = 0 FACET chartKey TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 30
